[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Molina Healthcare, a publicly traded managed care and health insurance company listed on the NYSE under ticker MOH, operates an IT center in Albuquerque, New Mexico through a separately registered subsidiary, Molina Healthcare Data Center, Inc. The company announced the new IT center on August 20, 2008, and the subsidiarys appearance in New Mexico Finance Authority records suggests the facility was financed in part through state industrial revenue bonds or a similar public finance mechanism commonly used to attract corporate data center investment, a financing pattern also seen with other economic development-linked facilities such as Fidelitys Nebraska data center elsewhere in this registry. As with other healthcare and financial enterprise operators in this registry, the Albuquerque facility exists to support Molinas own claims processing, member services, and health plan administration technology rather than functioning as commercial colocation space for outside tenants. This registry could not independently confirm the facilitys current megawatt capacity or operational details beyond the original 2008 announcement. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
